3060.title: Automation-created threads lose their recorded parent
3060.rootCauseOneLine: The automation dispatcher stores the creator thread ID but omits it from the thread spawn request.
3060.proposedFix: Conditionally pass the stored creator thread ID as parentThreadId when spawning a new agent-run thread.
3060.caveats: The visible sidebar hierarchy follows from the verified missing parent field; no live UI screenshot was needed to establish the backend relationship.
